title: FROM: Full Cast and Characters Guide
hook: FROM is an ensemble horror series with a large cast of recurring characters spread across the town's two main locations. Here is every main cast member and the character they play, verified against Wikipedia and official sources.

sections.heading: The core cast
sections.body: FROM works as a true ensemble drama, with its tension and mythology carried by a large group of residents whose roles overlap across survival, leadership, faith, family, and mystery. At the center is Harold Perrineau's Boyd Stevens, the town sheriff and its de facto leader, but the series constantly widens its focus to include the Matthews family, the town's medical and spiritual figures, Colony House leadership, and several long-running survivors tied closely to the show's deeper questions. The cast balances newcomers with characters who have lived in the town far longer, which gives the series both emotional immediacy and a wider historical perspective. That mix is a big part of why the show's character web feels layered, with each performer contributing to a story built around group dynamics as much as individual arcs.

sections.heading: Character by character
sections.body:
Harold Perrineau plays Boyd Stevens, the town sheriff and de facto leader.

Catalina Sandino Moreno plays Tabitha Matthews, a newcomer who becomes central to the show's mythology.

Eion Bailey plays Jim Matthews, Tabitha's husband, who dies in Season 4.

Simon Webster plays Ethan Matthews, the young son of Jim and Tabitha.

Hannah Cheramy plays Julie Matthews, the teenage daughter of Jim and Tabitha.

David Alpay plays Jade Herrera, an architect who becomes central to the show's symbol and pattern decoding.

Scott McCord plays Victor, a long-time survivor who has lived in the town since childhood and holds the oldest memories of the place.

Ricky He plays Kenny Liu, a deputy and Boyd's right hand.

Chloe Van Landschoot plays Kristi Miller, the town's doctor.

Elizabeth Saunders plays Donna Raines, the leader of Colony House.

Shaun Majumder plays Father Rudra Khatri, the town's priest, who dies in the series.

Pegah Ghafoori plays Fatima Hassan, Ellis's wife, whose health becomes a major Season 4 storyline.

Corteon Moore plays Ellis Stevens, Boyd's son.

Avery Konrad plays Sara Myers, a Township diner worker whose storyline from Season 1 onward connects to the town's supernatural system.

faq.a: Harold Perrineau plays Boyd Stevens in FROM.

faq.q: Is Victor a main character in FROM?
faq.a: Yes. Victor is one of the show's central recurring figures, played by Scott McCord. He has lived in the town since childhood and is one of the longest-running survivors, making him crucial to the show's mythology.

faq.q: Who plays Jim Matthews in FROM?
faq.a: Eion Bailey plays Jim Matthews in FROM.
